description: This is a server-side route handler file for the invoice detail/edit page in a SvelteKit application. It handles data loading, invoice update, cancellation, sending, marking as paid, and PDF download functionalities by interacting with API endpoints. The code manages fetching invoice data, related accounts, contacts, organization settings, templates, and provides various actions for invoice management.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads invoice details, related accounts, contacts, organization settings, and templates; transforms and returns the aggregated data for rendering.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating invoice data via PUT request with form data, including CRM relationships and line items.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the invoice by POSTing to the appropriate endpoint and redirects to the invoices list.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the invoice via API call and confirms success.

methods.name: markPaid
methods.description: Records a payment against the invoice using form data and API POST request.

methods.name: downloadPdf
methods.description: Fetches the invoice PDF from the backend API, converts it to base64, and returns it for download.
